Add a tooltip that puts each value in context

Source: R/add_context_tooltip.R
add_context_tooltip.Rd

Adds a tooltip to a layer that shows, on hover (or tap on touch screens), a feature's value together with where it stands among all features: its rank, the share of features with a lower value, the difference with the average, and a small distribution strip with the feature marked.

Usage

add_context_tooltip(
  map,
  layer_id,
  column,
  name_column = NULL,
  label = column,
  weight = NULL,
  unit = "features",
  locale = "en-US",
  digits = 1,
  prefix = "",
  suffix = "",
  diff_suffix = NULL,
  color = NULL,
  highlight = TRUE,
  highlight_color = "#1f2328",
  labels = context_labels()
)

Arguments

map

A map created with mapgl::maplibre() or mapgl::mapboxgl().

layer_id

ID of the layer to summarise: a polygon layer (such as mapgl::add_fill_layer()) or a point layer (such as mapgl::add_circle_layer() or mapgl::add_symbol_layer()). Its source must be an sf object or inline GeoJSON added in R; vector tile sources are not supported.

column

Name of the numeric column to show.

name_column

Optional column with feature names, shown as the tooltip's title.

label

Name of the variable shown in the panel. Defaults to column.

weight

Optional numeric column used to weight the average, for example population.

unit

Name for the features, shown as "14 of 528 unit".

locale

Locale for number formatting, such as "en-US" or "es-AR".

digits

Number of decimals for values. Values of a million or more are abbreviated, such as 12.4M.

prefix, suffix

Text added before and after each value, such as "$" or "%".

diff_suffix

Text added after the difference between the view and the overall average. NULL (the default) uses suffix, except when suffix contains "%": a difference between percentages is in percentage points, so the points label is used instead.

color

Color for the feature's marker on the distribution strip. NULL (the default) uses the layer's own color scale when it is an interpolate() or step_expr() on column, and blue otherwise.

highlight

If TRUE, outlines the feature under the pointer.

highlight_color

Color of that outline.

labels

Panel texts, as returned by context_labels().

Value

The modified map object.

Details

Use it instead of the layer's own tooltip argument: with both, two tooltips are shown.

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
library(mapgl)

maplibre(center = c(-64, -38.5), zoom = 3.4) |>
  add_fill_layer(
    id = "deptos",
    source = ar_departments,
    fill_color = interpolate(
      column = "growth",
      values = c(-10, 0, 10),
      stops = c("#b2182b", "#f7f7f7", "#2166ac")
    )
  ) |>
  add_context_tooltip(
    layer_id = "deptos",
    column = "growth",
    name_column = "department",
    label = "Population growth",
    unit = "departments",
    suffix = "%"
  )
} # }
